name: Samsara
description: Samsara is a connected-operations platform for fleets and physical operations, combining fleet telematics, real-time GPS tracking, routing and dispatch, fuel and compliance tools, maintenance diagnostics, AI cameras, equipment tracking, workforce apps, reporting, and an open integration platform.
best_for: Midmarket and enterprise fleets that want telematics, safety cameras, equipment tracking, maintenance, compliance, routing, and workforce workflows on one connected operations platform.
features: Real-time GPS fleet tracking with live maps, trip history, geofences, speed and harsh-driving visibility
Routing and dispatch tools with route optimization and commercial navigation
Fuel, idling, vehicle diagnostics, fault-code monitoring, and preventive maintenance workflows
FMCSA ELD/HOS compliance and driver/fleet applications
AI dash cameras, driver coaching, safety reporting, and in-cab alerts
Equipment, trailer, and asset tracking alongside vehicle telematics
Open API plus an App Marketplace with 350+ integrations

tiers.name: Connected Operations platform
tiers.notes: Samsara directs buyers to Check our prices / Talk to sales rather than publishing a universal numeric fleet subscription price on its current product pages.

pros: One platform spans vehicles, trailers, equipment, cameras, maintenance, compliance, and workforce workflows
Real-time GPS and telematics integrate with safety and maintenance data instead of operating as a standalone tracker
Open API and a large app marketplace support broader operational integrations
cons: No public universal numeric subscription price on the current product pages
Hardware and solution mix can make total cost dependent on the exact deployment
The breadth of the platform can be more than a small fleet needs
